$comment: Roles and permissions. Edit this file to add a role or change what one can do; no code changes are required. src/domain/roles.ts validates it at startup and is the only thing that reads it. Permission checks are declarative: a role holds a list of permission keys, optionally with a ':*' suffix to grant a whole group, or '*' for everything.

permissions.description: View clients, their controls and their evidence history
Change which requirement profiles a client is assessed against
Record a control's state against a client
Create a read-only client portal link
See who has access to this MSP

roles.label: Owner
roles.description: Runs the MSP. Full access, including managing who else has access.

roles.label: Operator
roles.description: Day-to-day technician. Manages clients and evidence, but cannot change who has access.

roles.label: Read only
roles.description: Can see everything and change nothing. For account managers and auditors.
